description: A progressive TypeScript framework for Node.js backends: from a small API in one file to efficient, scalable, enterprise-grade systems 🚀

latest_release.body:
## v12.4.1 (2026-11-09)

#### Features
* `platform-node`
  * [#18435](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18435) feat(node): inject requests into the node adapter like the fastify one ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))
  * [#18439](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18439) feat(node): set req.route on the node adapter like express does ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))

#### Bug fixes
* `core`
  * [#18385](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18385) fix(core): roll back modules on failed lazy load ([@Asadshah7950](https://github.com/Asadshah7950))

#### Enhancements
* `common`, `core`
  * [#18429](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18429) fix(core,common): warn when decorator metadata is missing ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))

#### Dependencies
* `platform-ws`
  * [#18468](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18468) chore(deps): bump ws from 8.22.0 to 8.22.1 ([@dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot))

#### Committers: 8
- Abdellatif Anaflous ([@hktitof](https://github.com/hktitof))
- Asad Ali Shah ([@Asadshah7950](https://github.com/Asadshah7950))
- G ([@gjija](https://github.com/gjija))
- Kamil Mysliwiec ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))
- Maksym Lyskov ([@maxymlyskov](https://github.com/maxymlyskov))
- Roman Khegay ([@thekhegay](https://github.com/thekhegay))
- Thiago Nascimento ([@ThiagoACNascimento](https://github.com/ThiagoACNascimento))
- WooSeung Kim ([@beyondwin](https://github.com/beyondwin))
